name: mind-map
description: Short-term working memory for Claude Code that survives /clear. Automatically maintains a small mind-map file (Active Focus, Graveyard, Pending Work) and restores it into context at every session start.

nudge_turns.title: Nudge interval (turns)
nudge_turns.description: How many turns the mind-map may go stale before Claude is asked to refresh it at the end of a turn. Default: 4.
